# Calculate Love

> Calculate Love (https://calculatelove.online/) is a free website of love, astrology and numerology calculators and guides. Visitors enter names, dates of birth or birth details and get a love percentage, compatibility reading, horoscope, kundali result or numerology number, plus short explanatory articles about what each result means. All tools are free to use in the browser; results are for fun and self-reflection.

## Tools

- Love calculators: love percentage by name, love by date of birth, love percentage on paper, crush calculator, friendship calculator, name compatibility and the classic FLAMES game.
- Marriage and compatibility: love or arranged marriage calculator, love compatibility by zodiac sign, and when will I get married.
- Astrology: daily love horoscope, daily rashifal, zodiac signs, kundali, kundali matching, porutham matching and birth chart calculator.
- Numerology: life path calculator, numerology calculator and name numerology.
- Guides: the blog explains how the love calculator works, what a love percentage means, how FLAMES works, soulmates, friendship compatibility and love versus arranged marriage.
